name: Asada Loaded Fries with Guacamole & Sour Cream
whyItWorks: A mountain of deep-fried crinkle fries piled with grilled flank steak, melted jack and cheddar, heavy sour cream, guacamole, diced raw onions, and spicy jalapenos creates a severe inflammatory cocktail for gut patients.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Extreme Danger Warning: Steer completely clear during any active symptoms. Order a plain burger or grilled cheese instead.
